name: Chemistry of Materials
tagline: Solid-state chemistry, ceramics, composites, and functional material design.
seo_title: Chemistry of Materials — paper summaries, news & innovations | Chemisters
seo_description: Follow Chemisters Chemistry of Materials on LinkedIn and Facebook: paper summaries, news and innovations in solid-state materials, semiconductors, porous frameworks, ceramics and energy materials.

definition.lead: Materials chemistry designs and makes substances with useful properties: strong, light, conductive, magnetic, transparent, porous or responsive.
definition.body: It connects atomic structure to performance, from battery electrodes and semiconductors to ceramics, glasses, alloys and porous frameworks. New materials often decide which technologies become possible.

timeline.title: Cheap steel
timeline.text: Henry Bessemer patents a process to make steel in bulk.
timeline.why: Steel became the backbone of industry.

timeline.title: The transistor
timeline.text: John Bardeen, Walter Brattain and William Shockley demonstrate the transistor at Bell Labs.
timeline.why: The start of the semiconductor age.

timeline.title: The integrated circuit
timeline.text: Jack Kilby demonstrates the first integrated circuit.
timeline.why: Many devices on one piece of semiconductor.

timeline.title: Low-loss optical fibre
timeline.text: Corning researchers make glass fibre clear enough for long-distance communication.
timeline.why: The basis of the internet's backbone.

timeline.title: High-temperature superconductors
timeline.text: Bednorz and Müller find superconductivity in a copper oxide ceramic.
timeline.why: Opened a new family of superconductors.

timeline.title: Framework design
timeline.text: Bernard Hoskins and Richard Robson describe designed coordination frameworks.
timeline.why: A blueprint for building crystals from molecular parts.

timeline.title: MOF-5
timeline.text: Omar Yaghi's group reports a highly porous, stable metal–organic framework.
timeline.why: MOFs became a major materials class.

timeline.title: The Materials Genome Initiative
timeline.text: The United States launches a programme to speed up materials discovery.

timeline.title: Nobel Prize for MOFs
timeline.text: Awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi.
